title: 2nd Consultations & MAG Meeting
content: Onsite and online registration is now open for the IGF 2026 2nd Open Consultations & Multistakeholder Advisory Group (MAG) Meeting, taking place at the Geneva International Conference Centre, Switzerland, from 7 to 9 September.
